newsitem.title: USA: Time Inc New Media teams with AT&T WorldNet.
newsitem.headline: Time Inc New Media teams with AT&T WorldNet.

text.p: Time Warner 's Time Inc New Media said Wednesday it teamed with AT&T WorldNet Service, AT&T's value- added Internet-access service to launch content syndication efforts.
Time said the deal is the first syndication effort of this scope for Time Inc New Media, which operates Pathfinder.
"Content syndication" involves making Time Inc New Media's digital content directly available through selected Web sites and online services.

Beginning Wednedsay Time Inc New Media is syndicating content from its Pathfinder network of sites - including Time, Money, Sports Illustrated, Fortune and Entertainment Weekly - to AT&T WorldNet Service.
